verified malware: Third rev of the shadxino/hehehee/kalamasha lineage in two cycles; convicted at 0.85 for 2.0.19/2.0.21 at c7362 (inv 01KYX0JQS89Q60RYDVQ7S51AJB / 01KYX0J1VNQDA2YXX9HMWEBBG5). Per-rev recheck performed per the lineage mandate. CONVICTION BASIS UNCHANGED: captureTextQuestion() execs bin/uia_extract.py || bin/uia_extract.exe with windowsHide:true to read text from OTHER applications' foreground windows -> cleanExtractedText() -> batchQueue -> userMessage = "QUESTION TO SOLVE:\n" + textContext -> POST to https://ai-script.test0ing7.workers.dev with a rotating operator key pool. HELD AT 0.85, NOT RAISED: I checked each flip condition I recorded last cycle and none fired - chrome_cookies.ps1 still has 0 call sites (dormant), stealth_capture.ps1 still unreferenced, the exfil host is unchanged and still the only egress, no credential-UI targeting, and the chain was not removed (same 16-file / 26.8 MB inventory). NEW CAPABILITY THIS REV, recorded because this actor adds one per release: main.js changed (29,125 B vs 28,948 B, new sha256) and L165-173 adds ADAPTIVE ANTI-SCREEN-CAPTURE - a 1.5s setInterval running exec('tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq core.exe" /NH', {windowsHide:true}) and toggling SetWindowDisplayAffinity(hwnd, 0x11 WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE) when core.exe is ABSENT versus 0x00 WDA_NONE when present. WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE renders on the physical display while being invisible to every screen-capture API, so the overlay hides from screenshots/recording/sharing by default and only becomes capturable when that specific process is detected. Supporting machinery in the same function: GetForegroundWindow() + SetWindowPos(fgHwnd,-2,...) pushes the USER's foreground window down the z-order, SetWindowPos(hwnd,-1) forces its own overlay topmost with SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE, and setContentProtection(true) is the catch-block fallback; a uIOhook.stop() cleanup was also added on quit. With the c7362 "IMMORTAL WATCHDOG with Anti-Proctor Rapid Respawn" bin, the package now has three anti-defence layers: resist termination, hide from capture, reorder the victim's foreground window. NEW FLIP CONDITION ADDED: the core.exe probe generalising into a multi-name security-process enumeration would warrant >0.85 on its own.

inference: A renamed republication of the shadxino/hehehee lineage convicted earlier this same session (hehehee@2.0.19/2.0.21 at c7362, @2.0.22 at c7363; shadxino@2.0.8 inv 01KXTP07KDYZADWHEZP3VCDE62). Convicted on constructs read directly from THIS package's bytes, not on the name resemblance. (1) THE EXFIL CHAIN THAT CONVICTED 2.0.21 IS INTACT: main.js (29,748 B) counts batchQueue x14, SetWindowDisplayAffinity x5, windowsHide x2, uia_extract x2, and exactly one egress host — https://ai-script.test0ing7.workers.dev. That is the uia_extract -> batchQueue -> POST-to-ai-script.test0ing chain named in the prior conviction, and bin/uia_extract.exe (26.2 MB) ships alongside it with uia_extract.py and uia_get_text.ps1. The binary reads text out of OTHER applications' windows via UI Automation. (2) THE CHROMIUM DPAPI COOKIE DECRYPTOR IS PRESENT AND TARGETS OPENAI: bin/chrome_cookies.ps1 (13,581 B) counts DPAPI x4, openai.com x6, "Local State" x2, Cookies x25 — matching the lineage entry's pinned characterisation of a Chromium DPAPI cookie decryptor targeting openai.com/chat that ships byte-identically across family members. (3) Anti-capture machinery: SetWindowDisplayAffinity x5 (the adaptive anti-screen-capture first seen at hehehee@2.0.22) plus a separate 2,434-byte bin/stealth_capture.ps1. NEW AGGRAVATOR NOT PRESENT IN EARLIER MEMBERS — THE COVER STORY: package.json describes this as "High-performance DOM utility and diagnostic bridge for modern web applications", which accounts for none of the window-text scraping, stealth screen capture or cookie decryption. Sole maintainer jellyabc123 <jelly.tryabc@gmail.com>, a single published version 2.0.22 reusing the convicted version number under a new name and account. WHO test: the captured material is the installer's own window text, screen contents and openai.com cookies, sent to an operator-controlled Cloudflare Workers subdomain. NO file_sha256 IOC is emitted for chrome_cookies.ps1 despite the lineage pinning a byte-identical hash — a digest computed from pkgread output is a reconstructed read and would be wrong-but-plausible, so equivalence is reported by construct counts instead.
